info.title: Huntress CTF 2026 Game Master
info.description: Authenticated player API for listing, starting, resuming, downloading, checking, and submitting generic challenge attempts. Every selected active compounding challenge returns a questions array aligned one-for-one with answer_ids; each question names its artifact, exact objective, normalization, and answer_format without exposing the private expected value. Pairing: POST ?op=pair through the trusted CourseStack proxy to receive one personal bearer for your enabled event. Use that bearer for direct HTTPS access from any compatible device. Repeated pairing returns already_paired; only explicit reset replaces a credential.

get.summary: List challenges, inspect an attempt, download an assigned artifact, or read this API description.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: List one release day (0 = welcome lane) instead of the smart default.

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: List one lane instead of the smart default.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: List every released challenge instead of the smart default.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: List challenges whose id contains this text.

200.description: JSON result, including the public questions contract for a selected challenge, or private artifact bytes when op is artifact.

409.description: Attempt state conflict. Selected-challenge conflicts such as start_required still include the public questions contract.

post.summary: Start or resume, submit answers, or retry. On routes with separate qualified pools, regular untimed play is the default; run_for_time:true opts into a fresh timed Hall of Fame attempt. Pair once through the authenticated proxy.

op.description: practice is a legacy continuation operation; new dual-pool routes use start or retry without run_for_time for regular play.

run_for_time.description: On a dual-pool route, true selects a fresh timed ranking attempt; omitted or false selects regular untimed play. Single Solve and legacy routes do not accept this property.

oneOf.description: Use query op=pair when op is omitted from the JSON body; an empty body needs no JSON header.

200.description: Attempt/answer result, or token and expires_at for first proxy-authenticated pairing.

409.description: Attempt conflict, or already_paired. Repeating pair does not rotate or redisclose the credential. Explicit proxy-authenticated reset:true is required to replace it.

post.description: POST ?op=pair accepts an empty body with no Content-Type header, or application/json {}. Pairing and explicit reset require the trusted proxy; a direct bearer cannot issue credentials. Gameplay POSTs and nonempty pairing bodies require application/json. Normal pairing never rotates an existing token.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Use pair for the header-free, empty-body pairing request through the authenticated proxy.

courseStackProxy.name: x-vercel-oidc-token
courseStackProxy.description: Trusted workload authentication plus provider-supplied player identity headers; not a player-issued JWT.

token.description: Private credential returned once. Never put it in chat, logs or shared files.
